requirements.description: User requires the building to be located near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.

The building is to be converted into a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is essential. Value set to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.
User requires energy class C or better, so classes A1 through C are accepted. Surface, location, capacity and transport requirements are outside the energy column scope and were not included.

The user explicitly specified at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 850. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The future use (student residence), energy class, public transport access, and the city of Turin are not reference columns or current-state typology criteria, so they are not included here.

output.explanation: Selects office-type properties (Uffici e assimilabili) with surface_area >= 850 sqm, energy class A1-A4/B/C, mobility score >= 71 and education score >= 75, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by haversine distance to that point. The 60-occupant capacity is not a requirement the agents extracted and has no column, so it is not filtered.
